d:
Cornered by public backlash, her dream begins to fracture.
Akane believed one more effort could save everything—until she steps into a place where “opportunity” demands a price.

“Just endure it,” they said—
and suddenly, there is no choice left.

Behind closed doors, unseen by anyone,
she starts paying a cost she can never take back.

When the applause fades and the cameras go dark,
all that remains is a silent exchange—and a self slowly breaking apart.

This isn’t redemption. It’s the continuation of her fall.
